modules.module_title: Conduct development of Detailed Models mechatronic system components

pcs.pc_description: Proficiently use modeling and simulation software (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, ANSYS, SolidWorks) to create accurate and detailed models of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and control components.
Develop understanding of the principles and interactions of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and control systems within mechatronic applications.
Identify and perform validation of the developed models against experimental data and real-world scenarios to ensure their accuracy and reliability. Update models based on validation results.

modules.module_title: Implement simulations & analyze results to predict the performance and behavior of mechatronic systems.

pcs.pc_description: Configure and run simulations using advanced software tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, ANSYS, COMSOL Multiphysics) to model the behavior of mechatronic systems under various operating conditions.
Analyze simulation results to understand the performance, efficiency, and potential failure modes of mechatronic systems.

Prepare detailed reports and visualizations to document the simulation process, results, and conclusions. Effectively communicate findings to stakeholders, including engineers, project managers, and clients, providing clear recommendations for design improvements.

modules.module_title: Perform integration, validation & optimization activities for models.

pcs.pc_description: Integrate individual component models into comprehensive, system-level simulations to assess overall system performance and interaction.
Validate the integrated models by comparing simulation results with experimental data and real- world performance.
Perform optimization techniques to enhance system performance, including improving efficiency, reducing costs, and increasing reliability.
Implement validated and optimized models into the design and development process, ensuring they are effectively utilized to enhance the final product.

modules.module_title: Conduct testing of sensors, actuators, control systems, and mechanical components to meet performance specifications and functions

pcs.pc_description: Develop detailed test plans and procedures that outline the specific tests to be conducted, including performance criteria, testing conditions, and measurement methods

Conduct tests systematically according to the established test plans, ensuring accurate and consistent execution. Collect and record test data meticulously, ensuring that all relevant parameters and outcomes are documented for further analysis.

Analyze the collected test data to determine whether the components meet the required performance specifications and function correctly. Identify any deviations from expected performance, diagnose underlying issues, and recommend corrective actions or improvements to enhance component reliability and effectiveness.

modules.module_title: Integrate tested components into a cohesive mechatronic system.

pcs.pc_description: Develop integration plans that outline the step- by-step process for combining sensors, actuators, control systems, and mechanical components into a unified system.

Perform the integration of tested components according to the established plans, ensuring proper physical and functional connections. Address and resolve compatibility issues that may arise during integration.
Conduct comprehensive system-level tests to verify that the integrated mechatronic system operates correctly and meets the overall design and performance specifications.

modules.module_title: Perform system-level validation activities for continuous improvement

pcs.pc_description: Develop validation plans that include test objectives, methodologies, and success criteria for evaluating the entire mechatronic system.
Collect and meticulously analyze data from system-level validation tests to assess the overall performance, reliability, and efficiency of the integrated mechatronic system.

Identify & use validation results to pinpoint areas where the system can be enhanced, whether through design modifications, component upgrades, or software adjustments. Recommend specific changes or optimizations based on data-driven insights to improve system functionality and performance.
Integrate recommended improvements into the system design and conduct iterative validation to ensure that changes achieve the desired outcomes.
